wire.errors.notifications.store_busy.role: error sentence painted by the desktop Notifications page
wire.errors.notifications.store_busy.note: notifications.db met lock contention through its retry budget. Nothing was written. The client also reads the machine code store_busy to offer a retry.

wire.errors.notifications.store_full.role: error sentence painted by the desktop Notifications page
wire.errors.notifications.store_full.note: {where} is the config directory the store lives in (a path, keep it verbatim). The volume is full; retrying alone will not help.

wire.errors.notifications.store_unavaila.role: error sentence painted by the desktop Notifications page
wire.errors.notifications.store_unavaila.note: {where} is the config directory (a path, keep it verbatim). The store could not be opened or is damaged; retrying will not help.

wire.errors.notifications.unknown_item.role: error sentence for an item id the inbox does not hold
wire.errors.notifications.unknown_item.note: Shown when a detail link names an item that was pruned, deleted with its conversation, or an ask that is no longer open.
